conditions: Free launches exist but are 'fully booked into 2027' — effectively unavailable; you can join an email waitlist by starting a launch

Premium $12/launch is 'the only way to launch right now' — launch tomorrow, guaranteed dofollow backlink, capped at 10 premium slots/day
Account required (Google, GitHub, or email/password sign-up)
requirements: A tech product/project to launch; all launches happen at 8:00 AM UTC
Account registration before reaching the submit form
For the free tier's dofollow link: top-3 daily ranking + their badge displayed on your site
preparation: Project name, URL, tagline, description, logo/screenshots, category
$12 for Premium launch if you need a date this year
Optional: $59 SEO Growth Package adds a dedicated review article plus the Premium launch
workflow: Open /projects/submit and fill the launch form
Choose Free (waitlist, booked into 2027) or Premium $12 for next-day launch

Premium guarantees the dofollow backlink from a DR-71 domain
watchFor: Free tier is effectively closed — booked into 2027; don't count on it
